plot: On a sunny morning Grandma's new robot vacuum keeps following Max around the living room; he is sure it wants his tail and hides on the sofa, Dog's ball block fails, then Max discovers the robot is only following the cupcake crumbs he keeps dropping, cleans his whiskers and makes friends with it, but when he pushes it home it stops just before tomorrow's visitor.

beats.say: Aaah! That green thing is chasing me! Run, run, run!
Beep, beep! A round green machine rolls right after Max.
Why is this thing following me everywhere I go?
It's a sunny morning in Grandma's living room. A brand new day.
Max, dear, meet my new robot vacuum. It cleans the floor.
It cleans? It looks like it wants to eat my tail!
Max takes a big bite of his pink cupcake. Munch, munch, munch.
Silly cat. It only goes where it's needed. Be kind!
Grandma goes to the kitchen. The robot turns around... toward Max.
Nope! Not today, robot! You can't catch this cat!
Max runs to the window. Beep, beep. The robot follows.
I go left, it goes left. I go right, it goes right!
Hi, Max! Are you playing chase with the new robot? Fun!
It's not a game, Dog. That robot wants me. Only me!
Maybe it wants a friend? Hello, robot! Do you like belly rubs?
The robot rolls right past Dog. It doesn't even say hello.
Huh. It likes you more than me. That's a little rude.
Eek! What's that buzzing noise? Is it a giant bug?
Mouse! Grandma's new robot is hunting me. Help me hide!
Hunting you? Robots don't hunt cats, Max. Do they?
This one does. Watch. I'll stand very, very still.
Max stands still like a statue. Beep... beep... beep. It comes closer.
If it catches me, Grandma's robot will vacuum my fluffy tail!
Okay, okay! Climb up high. Robots can't climb sofas!
Max jumps onto the big blue sofa. Up, up, and safe.
Ha! I'm the king of the sofa! You can't reach me now!
The robot waits under the sofa. Beep. Beep. It won't go away.
I can't stay up here forever. I'll miss lunch!
I have a plan! I'll block the robot with my red ball!
Dog pushes his red ball in front of the robot. Bump!
The robot taps the ball, turns a little, and keeps going.
It went around my ball! That robot is smarter than me!
Everybody is smarter than you, Dog. No offense.
None taken! I'm a happy dog, not a smart dog.
We have to stop it before Grandma comes back and sees this!
Max sits on the sofa, very grumpy. He takes another bite. Munch.
Why me? I didn't do anything. I'm a good cat!
Then Max looks down. Something is right next to his paws.
Wait. What are these little pink dots on the sofa?
Those are crumbs, Max. Cupcake crumbs! Lots and lots of them.
Crumbs? There are crumbs on the sofa... and on the floor too!
Max looks back at the floor. A long line of pink crumbs.
From the rug, to the window, to the sofa. Everywhere Max walked.
The robot isn't chasing me. It's chasing my crumbs!
And who is dropping all the crumbs, Max? Hmm?
Me. It's me. I'm the messy one. Oh, my whiskers.
Look! You have crumbs on your whiskers too! And on your nose!
Max wipes his whiskers. Wipe, wipe. The cupcake is all gone.
Okay, robot. Come and get the crumbs. I won't run anymore.
The robot hums happily. Beep, beep. The crumbs disappear one by one.
Max watches it clean his messy trail. It's actually a little cute.
Thank you, robot. Sorry I called you a tail-eater.
Beep! The robot does a little happy spin. All clean!
My goodness. Why is everyone smiling at my vacuum?
Grandma, it wasn't hunting me. It was cleaning up after me!
Of course, dear. It goes where the crumbs are. Like I said!
Can it clean my food bowl too? I'm very messy!
Maybe tomorrow, Dog. Tomorrow is a very big day.
Next time, I'll check my own whiskers before I run away.
Max gives the robot a little push. Go home, buddy.
The robot rolls to its corner. Beep... beeep... and then, nothing.
Oh no. It stopped. And our visitor comes tomorrow!
Did I break Grandma's robot? Uh-oh. Tomorrow I fix it!
